patches.title: Prioritize Countertop Dining Table Search
patches.principle: Search all countertops and dining tables before checking other furniture for the target object.
patches.when_to_apply: When searching for an object to clean and no target is visible.

patches.title: Skip Kitchen Appliances Initially
patches.principle: Avoid stoveburners, microwaves, and coffeemachines during initial search; they rarely hold cleanable objects.
patches.when_to_apply: When open surfaces are still unsearched and the target is missing.

patches.title: Pick-Clean-Place Without Interruption
patches.principle: Once object is picked, go straight to sink, clean, then go to destination and place without detours.
patches.when_to_apply: After acquiring the object to be cleaned.
